items.title: 8.8 Equilibrium constant aur equilibrium ki position (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8, printed pages 173-174.

blocks.title: Equilibrium ki position
blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position equilibrium mixture mein maujood products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdaron ko kehte hain.

1864 mein Norwegian chemists C. Guldberg (1836-1902) aur P. Waage (1833-1900) ne equilibrium par bohat se reaction systems ki tarkeebein napin aur paya ke kisi bhi reversible reaction ke liye products ki equilibrium concentrations ke hasil-e-zarb, har ek balanced muadle mein apne coefficient par uthai hui, ka reactants ki equilibrium concentrations ke hasil-e-zarb, har ek apne coefficient par uthai hui, se tanasub halaat ke di gai set mein hamesha mustaqil hai. Aam reaction aA + bB se cC + dD ke liye Kc = [C]^c [D]^d / [A]^a [B]^b. Law of mass action se reaction ki rate reactants ke faal masses (active masses), balanced muadle ke coefficients par uthaye hue, ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai; active mass ka matlab mol dm-3 mein molar concentration hai, jo murabba brackets mein likhi jati hai.

A + B se C + D ke liye forward rate = kf [A][B], jahan kf forward rate constant hai, aur reverse rate = kr [C][D], jahan kr reverse rate constant hai. Equilibrium par dono rates barabar hain, kf [A][B] = kr [C][D], to kf / kr = [C][D] / [A][B]. Baen taraf do constants ka tanasub hai, to yeh ek aur constant hai, equilibrium constant Kc: Kc = [C][D] / [A][B], equilibrium constant expression. aA + bB se cC + dD ke liye, coefficients a, b, c aur d ke saath, Kc = [C]^c [D]^d / [A]^a [B]^b.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe: barabar forward aur reverse rates se Kc ka ishtiqaq; chaar shaklein Kc, Kp, Kn aur Kx taalluqat Kp = Kc (RT)^delta n, Kp = Kx P^delta n aur Kp = Kn N^delta n ke saath; barabar aur ghair-barabar mole numbers ke liye Kc ki units; aur Samples 8.3 aur 8.4 ki do conversions. Neeche sabz patti Samples 8.1 aur 8.2 hal karti hai.
blocks.caption: Equilibrium constant, us ki chaar shaklein, un ke taalluqat aur units, chapter ke sample hisabat ke saath (topics 8.8 se 8.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Forward rate kf [A][B] ko reverse rate kr [C][D] ke barabar rakhne se kf / kr = [C][D] / [A][B] milta hai, ek constant jise Kc kehte hain, aur aam coefficients ke liye har concentration apne coefficient par uthai jati hai. Wahi tanasub partial pressures, moles ya mole fractions se likha ja sakta hai, aur shaklein delta n, gas moles ki tabdeeli, se juri hain; delta n sifar ho to chaaron barabar hain. Mole numbers barabar hon to Kc ki units nahi, jaise ester banne mein (4.03), warna units hoti hain, jaise ammonia ke liye (mol-2 dm6). 773 K par ammonia ka Kp Kc se kahin chhota hai kyunke delta n -2 hai.

blocks.prompt: Sn2+(aq) + 2Fe3+(aq) se Sn4+(aq) + 2Fe2+(aq), 4NH3(g) + 5O2(g) se 4NO(g) + 6H2O(g), aur PCl5(g) se PCl3(g) + Cl2(g) ke liye Kc likhein.
blocks.explanation: Kc = [Sn4+][Fe2+]^2 / ([Sn2+][Fe3+]^2); Kc = [NO]^4 [H2O]^6 / ([NH3]^4 [O2]^5); Kc = [PCl3][Cl2] / [PCl5]. Har concentration apne coefficient par uthai hui, products oopar reactants neeche.

items: Equilibrium ki position: products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdarein. Guldberg aur Waage (1864): aA + bB se cC + dD ke liye Kc = [C]^c [D]^d / [A]^a [B]^b kisi darja hararat par mustaqil hai.
Law of mass action se equilibrium par kf [A][B] = kr [C][D], to Kc = kf / kr = [C][D] / [A][B].
